slides.title: From how we work to why we exist.
slides.headline: From how we work to why we exist.

artwork.alt: Day 1 path: Functions and KFFM done. Purpose next, then Values, BHAG and 3HAG.

notes: We’ve mapped who owns what and how cash flows today. Now we step back: why does this company exist, and what does it stand for?

slides.title: A purpose expresses a contribution.
slides.headline: A purpose expresses a contribution.
notes: These are historical examples. Use them to discuss the contribution each purpose describes. Do not present them as newly verified current corporate statements.

panels.heading: “To experience the emotion of competition, winning, and crushing competitors.”
“We’re in business to save our home planet.”

slides.title: Why does your organization exist?
slides.headline: Why does your organization exist?
notes: Ask for initial reflections. Explain that the team will draft its statement after reviewing the examples.
Have every leader write before discussion. Ask what contribution remains meaningful beyond making money.
Explore differences. Agree on a useful statement without prolonged wordsmithing.
slides.support: What would be missed if you disappeared? Write independently. Share your answers. Agree on a working statement.
